dashboard_elements.body_text:
Filter - Date: Input the date range you want to view results for. Results are currently available for the last completed 24 months.
Filter - Page URL: Input the URL of the page or pages you want to see download clicks for. A reminder to input the various potential URL spellings.
Filter - Downloaded File: Input the PDF URL or URLs if you want to view results for a specific PDF. A reminder to input the various potential URL spellings. For example, include uppercase and lowercase versions if applicable, etc.
View or Download More Rows/Columns of Data: The current live view limit is 20 rows & 50 columns. To view or download more rows/columns of data, use the "Advanced data options" of the "Download Data" option. Go to the online guide for instructions.

query.filter_expression: matches_filter(${clicks.click_time_date}, `26 month`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.page_display_url}, `https://news.gov.bc.ca/releases%`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.target_display_url}, `%pdf%,%PDF%`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.target_display_url}, `https://govbcnews.azureedge.net/translations/releases%`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.target_display_url}, `%^_Chinese(Traditional)%,%^_Chinese(traditional)%,%^_French%,%^_Punjabi%`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.target_display_url}, `%LFS%,%LabourForce%`) AND matches_filter(${clicks.page_urlhost}, `news.gov.bc.ca`)
